title: First-order Leibniz sum at the identity matrix equals the trace
statement: Let ι be a finite index set with decidable equality and let H be a real ι×ι matrix. Write I for the ι×ι identity matrix, so I_{ab} = δ_{ab} (1 if a = b and 0 otherwise). Then Σ_{σ∈Perm(ι)} sgn(σ) · Σ_{m∈ι} (Π_{j∈ι∖{m}} I_{σ(j) j}) · H_{σ(m) m} = tr H. Here Perm(ι) is the finite group of permutations of ι, sgn(σ) ∈ {1, −1} is regarded as a real number, and tr H = Σ_{m∈ι} H_{mm}.
lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (H : Matrix ι ι ℝ), ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm ι, ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∑ m : ι, (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (σ j) j) * H (σ m) m = H.trace
